_comment: Glowsticks (#447): an item (inventory items.json, id glowstick) you crack for light in your armband's colour, worn on the chest. burn_seconds: how long a cracked stick glows (it keeps burning while stowed, and is gone when spent). enemy_night_share: the share of soldiers that carry one and show it at night while on patrol (never while fighting or chasing). enemy_drop_seconds: how long the lit stick of a soldier who dies keeps glowing where they fell. ground_max: lit sticks on the ground at once (the oldest goes out first). check_seconds: how often the server looks at who shows one; send_seconds: the shortest gap between two updates to clients. stick: the stick's size in metres [width, length], where it sits on the chest (metres, chest space: x right, y up, z back), and glow (how bright it is itself: past about 1 it blooms). light: the small light round it, colour from the band: energy, range (metres; short, so it is seen from afar but does not light a room) and max_lights (only the nearest this many on screen light anything; the rest still glow). spare_colour: an uncracked stick in the backpack or on the ground, [r, g, b].
